title: Small Space Heater!!
text:
Small Space Heater!!. This product came on time and was packaged with other items.

Pros: It actually heats. Compact and small. Somewhat durable design.

Cons: Draws a ton of electricity. Like more that a full floor space heater. Had a funny smell the first time using.

Overall this is a small, compact space heater on the cheap. It works as described, but draws a ton of electricity. If cost of electricity is no concern to you, then this is the perfect small space heater for you!
